title: v2 · Operator — adapter/shim metrics + user_logs actions

list.label: Datasource (F1 default — user_logs only ever lands on F1, never F3; fixed 2026-08-20, was defaulting to F3 and rendering the user_logs panels permanently empty)
list.name: datasource
enterprise
list.label: Enterprise
list.query: SELECT nm_enterprise AS __text, nm_enterprise AS __value FROM enterprises WHERE active = true ORDER BY nm_enterprise

list.name: user
list.label: User

options.content:
### Operator actions — two sources, two truths
**Top (Prometheus `packiot-prometheus`)** — the request-plane view from the two HTTP front doors: **operator-adapter** (`operator_adapter_requests_total`, the operator SPA's PO + downtime calls) and **ingest-shim** (`ingest_shim_requests_total`, Incoplast ingest auth/scope/publish). **⚠️ Both scrape jobs were added in THIS PR — they were unscraped before.** If these panels are flat 0 right after deploy, the scrape config hasn't taken effect yet (check `up{job=~"operator-adapter|ingest-shim"}` on the Infra board), not that no traffic flowed. **Bottom (Postgres F1 `packiot-postgres`)** — the persisted audit view from `user_logs` / `equipment_events` / `production_orders`, filterable by the vars above.

panels.title: operator-adapter request rate by action
panels.description: sum by(action) rate(operator_adapter_requests_total[5m]). action = downtime / po / po_stop / po_setup / po_replace / po_change_status / po_change_time / split. 🟡 was unscraped before this PR.

panels.title: operator-adapter request rate by outcome (edge_4xx / edge_5xx = red)
panels.description: sum by(outcome) rate(operator_adapter_requests_total[5m]). outcome = accepted / edge_4xx / edge_5xx / …. accepted carries traffic; edge_4xx = the adapter forwarded but edge-api rejected; edge_5xx = edge-api errored. 🟡 was unscraped before this PR.

panels.title: ingest-shim request rate by outcome (Incoplast ingest)
panels.description: sum by(outcome) rate(ingest_shim_requests_total[5m]). The Incoplast ingest front door — auth / scope / publish outcomes. 🟡 was unscraped before this PR; a flat 0 immediately post-deploy is a scrape-lag artefact, not silence.

panels.title: operator-adapter action × outcome (cumulative)
panels.description: operator_adapter_requests_total, instant. A quick matrix of which actions the adapter has served and how they resolved. 🟡 was unscraped before this PR.

panels.title: Operator actions over time (user_logs)
panels.description: Stacked PO actions / justifications / manual events from user_logs — shows when the floor is active. Postgres F1; respects the $enterprise / $user / $action_type filters.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(ts_log,'$__interval',0) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "PO Actions" FROM user_logs WHERE ts_log BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND category LIKE 'order-%' AND ('${user:csv}' = 'All' OR nm_user = ANY(string_to_array('${user:csv}', ','))) AND ('${enterprise:csv}' = '.*' OR id_enterprise IN (SELECT id_enterprise FROM enterprises WHERE nm_enterprise = ANY(string_to_array('${enterprise:csv}', ',')))) AND ('${action_type:csv}' = 'All' OR category = ANY(string_to_array('${action_type:csv}', ','))) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroup(ts_log,'$__interval',0) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "Justifications" FROM user_logs WHERE ts_log BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND category IN ('event-justified','event-edited','manual-event-edited') AND ('${user:csv}' = 'All' OR nm_user = ANY(string_to_array('${user:csv}', ','))) AND ('${enterprise:csv}' = '.*' OR id_enterprise IN (SELECT id_enterprise FROM enterprises WHERE nm_enterprise = ANY(string_to_array('${enterprise:csv}', ',')))) AND ('${action_type:csv}' = 'All' OR category = ANY(string_to_array('${action_type:csv}', ','))) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroup(ts_log,'$__interval',0) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "Manual Events" FROM user_logs WHERE ts_log BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND category = 'manual-event-created' AND ('${user:csv}' = 'All' OR nm_user = ANY(string_to_array('${user:csv}', ','))) AND ('${enterprise:csv}' = '.*' OR id_enterprise IN (SELECT id_enterprise FROM enterprises WHERE nm_enterprise = ANY(string_to_array('${enterprise:csv}', ',')))) AND ('${action_type:csv}' = 'All' OR category = ANY(string_to_array('${action_type:csv}', ','))) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Pending events right now
panels.description: Open equipment_events with no ts_end — awaiting justification. Postgres F1; respects $enterprise.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM equipment_events WHERE ts_end IS NULL AND ('${enterprise:csv}' = '.*' OR id_enterprise IN (SELECT id_enterprise FROM enterprises WHERE nm_enterprise = ANY(string_to_array('${enterprise:csv}', ','))))

panels.title: Justification rate
panels.description: % of closed downtime events (ts_end set) that an operator categorised (cd_category filled). Postgres F1; respects $enterprise.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cd_category IS NOT NULL AND cd_category <> '') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ts_end IS NOT NULL), 0), 1) AS value FROM equipment_events WHERE ts_event >= $__timeFrom() AND ts_event <= $__timeTo() AND ('${enterprise:csv}' = '.*' OR id_enterprise IN (SELECT id_enterprise FROM enterprises WHERE nm_enterprise = ANY(string_to_array('${enterprise:csv}', ','))))

panels.title: Downtime events — pending vs justified over time
panels.description: Closed events (status=10) split by whether cd_category is filled. A rising Pending line means the floor is falling behind on justification. Postgres F1; respects $enterprise.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(ts_end,'$__interval',0) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "Pending" FROM equipment_events WHERE ts_end BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND ts_end IS NOT NULL AND ('${enterprise:csv}' = '.*' OR id_enterprise IN (SELECT id_enterprise FROM enterprises WHERE nm_enterprise = ANY(string_to_array('${enterprise:csv}', ',')))) AND (cd_category IS NULL OR cd_category = '') AND status = 10 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroup(ts_end,'$__interval',0) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "Justified" FROM equipment_events WHERE ts_end BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND ('${enterprise:csv}' = '.*' OR id_enterprise IN (SELECT id_enterprise FROM enterprises WHERE nm_enterprise = ANY(string_to_array('${enterprise:csv}', ',')))) AND cd_category IS NOT NULL AND status = 10 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Production orders started / finished over time
panels.description: PO lifecycle from production_orders (status>=2 started, status=3 finished). Correlate with shifts to spot idle periods. Postgres F1; respects $enterprise.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(ts_start,'$__interval',0) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "Started" FROM production_orders WHERE ts_start BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND ('${enterprise:csv}' = '.*' OR id_enterprise IN (SELECT id_enterprise FROM enterprises WHERE nm_enterprise = ANY(string_to_array('${enterprise:csv}', ',')))) AND status >= 2 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroup(ts_end,'$__interval',0) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "Finished" FROM production_orders WHERE ts_end BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND ('${enterprise:csv}' = '.*' OR id_enterprise IN (SELECT id_enterprise FROM enterprises WHERE nm_enterprise = ANY(string_to_array('${enterprise:csv}', ',')))) AND status = 3 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Per-user action log (user_logs audit trail)
panels.description: Full audit trail of operator actions from user_logs. Use the $user filter to scope to a single operator. Postgres F1; respects all three filters.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts_log AS "When", nm_user AS "User", category, COALESCE(payload->>'nmProductionOrder', '') AS "Product", COALESCE(payload->>'descCategory', '') AS "Category", COALESCE(payload->>'descSubcategory', payload->>'txtDowntimeNotes', payload->>'txtProductionOrderNotes', '') AS "Detail", id_equipment AS "Equipment" FROM user_logs WHERE ts_log BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND ('${user:csv}' = 'All' OR nm_user = ANY(string_to_array('${user:csv}', ','))) AND ('${enterprise:csv}' = '.*' OR id_enterprise IN (SELECT id_enterprise FROM enterprises WHERE nm_enterprise = ANY(string_to_array('${enterprise:csv}', ',')))) AND ('${action_type:csv}' = 'All' OR category = ANY(string_to_array('${action_type:csv}', ','))) ORDER BY ts_log DESC LIMIT 500
